_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling H342474 (2025-10-21, development Part 102 split; subject: "Country of Origin; USMCA; Marking; Verona Crystal LED Display Cabinet"). D570 rules on development data for the D590 error analysis. CBP held China. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 development suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (8528.59). Family: the family check (pcba_electronic_devices, 0.85); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (7: HUB and Interconnect Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs), Receiving Card (“RC”), Power Supply Unit, connectors, harnesses, bolts, washers). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups-dev-set.jsonl). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Mexico. Target Mexico by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for Mexico are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D590.
